items.note: The letter is addressed "Dear Ms. Alvarez."
Apartment 4B appears in the subject line, the body and the signature.
It says the heater "stopped working on October 2."
It says the problem was reported by phone on October 3 with no response.
It says "Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s °F."
It asks for the heater to be repaired "within 48 hours of this email."
It says "Section 12 of our lease requires the landlord to provide heat."
The tone is courteous, and it also sets a deadline and asks for confirmation, so it is polite but firm.
Rent isn't mentioned, and the letter makes no threats.
The whole letter, including the subject line, is about 115 words, which is under 150.
